entry_points.text: Freezer state file hidden on root; reads refresh bottom-up; writes accept only thawed/frozen.
Misc files for maxima(writable), current, peak, capacity, aggregate/local events; maxima hidden on root, capacity root-only; shared legacy/default descriptor.
Namespace ops with owner query; pids alloc sets unlimited ceiling, free plain deallocates.

Compat mask captures old word, strips unblockable, applies add/del/set, faults on bad pointers; affinity zero-extends/truncates and bounds length; ikconfig serves world-readable embedded slice with create/remove.

exports.text: Freeze requests frozen transition for freezable unfrozen tasks via signal or wakeup paths; thaw clears marker and wakes waiters; frozen sampled torn-safe.
Misc try-charge adds leaf-to-root failing on bad type/owner/capacity; uncharge releases ignoring empty/invalid; capacity setter validates selector then publishes ceiling.
Copy shares old ns without clone flag else needs admin plus accounting and css snapshot; free detaches from tree and releases refs ending deferred.

Pids binds alloc/fork/attach/release with legacy/unified files and threaded mode; rdma publishes charge/uncharge plus device register; charge validates and charges ancestors creating pools, uncharge walks to stop freeing idle pools.
Alloc gives zeroed container with empty pools or mem fail; free drains pools then frees; offline forces max limits; one table serves both hierarchies; names checked unique for display.
Stats refresh checks cpu id range/possible before update; tracing helper set registered with tracing type at init under module ownership.

hazards.text: Negative release warns as bug; pids peak plain unsynchronized best-effort; rdma missing pool warns, negative use warns-once yet applies; rstat needs global claim across irq/NMI; root non-freezable with fork bypass and legacy notice; writes reject unknown/malformed/unset; pids breach logs once with notify.

invariants.text: Migrate conforms to dest under mutex; frozen only if freezing with children/members quiesced; offline apply no-op; freeze sets bits/raises active, unfreeze clears/thaws; subtree ancestor-first with hotplug; fork skips root; self+parental compose effective, entry to frozen reverts ancestors.
Charge enforces per-group and platform caps per ancestor; breach events and rolls back full prefix; failures count local then ancestors with notify; watermarks rise only via retry.

Pids charge walks to root atomically, watermarking prefix, unwinding all on breach with EAGAIN+culprit, stopping before root; max takes unlimited keyword or sub-ceiling number atomically; current live, peak single-load, events local/hierarchical by flavour; atomics only.

Root reuses static zeroed object with unlimited maxima; views hide unset-capacity resources unless used; copy shares or needs admin+accounting+spin snapshot; install needs admin both sides, self-attach no-op.

Pools by-device on demand with unlimited ceilings; persist while use/bounded/peak/events nonzero else unlink/free; ceiling update tracks unlimited count; writes parse device+index+values rejecting repeats/negatives/unknown.

Reads under mutex list devices with numeric disambiguation, unlimited keyword, missing pools as unlimited/zero; breach counts requester+culprit locals then ancestors with notify; helpers via container/parent/current pin.

Stats update no-ops without path, needs preempt disabled, skips NMI without safe CAS; enqueue racy-tests then atomic self-to-null claim with single winner appending; cputime routes total plus nice/user/system/irq/force-idle categories.
Newly blocked bits offered to siblings when work pending; readiness ORs unblocked bits; shared redistribute skips exiting/unable, wakes gainers till empty.

Compat sigset merges narrow pairs low-first on big-endian else verbatim, faults on bad user; idle/irq forward to kernel tracking with irq discipline, empty variants mean compiled out; tracing gated by disabled key.

locks.text: Freezer mutex serializes state ops; derivation/apply need held mutex; traversals use RCU+online pin, subtree adds hotplug read lock.
Create snapshots css set under irq-safe spin without cgroup mutex; lookup pins proxy under task lock while referencing.
Global rdma mutex guards devices and all pool/charge/limit/read ops.

Cputime uses irq-saving sequence bracket then marks updated; mask strips unblockable, skips if unchanged else sighand spin; task freeze/thaw under irq-safe spin, synthetic wakeup takes sighand briefly.

state_machines.text: Count uncharged-charged at fork, then uncharged on cancel/release, moved on migrate; devices visible only after locked insert, unlinked before pools destroyed.
Recalc sets thread flag and never clears another thread; current wrapper clears only when false and not freezing.

Kernel tracking nests count, outermost exit traces+quiesces then leaves watching/idles, entry actives then resumes; NMI adds 1/2 by watching state, exit unwinds symmetrically with warnings on bad state.

structs.text: Pids state pairs cgroup node with atomic current/limit, plain high mark, two event files, and aggregate/local counters split by local-hit vs ancestor-caused failures; ceiling is pid-limit+1 with unlimited keyword.

Freezer carries cgroup node plus bitmask of freezing/frozen/online/self/parental with parent link; misc pairs node with per-resource max/usage/peak/counters plus event files, static root, capacity table, all-bits-set unlimited keyword.

Namespace links header with pinned root css set, owner userns and accounting; rdma resource holds ceiling/use/peak, pool binds device with fixed array, dual lists, totals, unlimited count and four event tallies; tracking is per-cpu nesting/state starting watching.
Compat rusage orders times then max/integral/fault/swap/block/message/signal/switch counters; bitmaps pack two narrow words per native word low-first with odd tail in one user window.

Vocab covers secure-virt misc labels, freezer state/freezing files, pids max/current/peak/events(+local unified), rdma handle/object names, max keyword, index/value tokens, ceiling/current/peak selectors; max writable, others read-only, hidden on root.
